title: Apple is killing the 'Do Not Track' setting in Safari because it could be used as a way to track people (AAPL)
text: Apple is killing the 'Do Not Track' setting in Safari because it could be used as a way to track people (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 7, 2019, 10:06 am 12 pts Apple is removing the "Do Not Track" setting from its Safari browser. The setting was supposed to tell advertisers and webmasters that you didn't want to be tracked, but it was rarely respected.
